name: webcraft
description: Build and secure VicroCode-ready web apps and hosted Python API tools with runtime, storage, data-delivery isolation, schema, dependency, credential, testing, and publishing guidance, plus one-click agent upload/deploy via the vco-wc- smart-deploy token, automatic re-upload after every change, project-id or project-name upgrades that never create duplicates, a project-local development log, agent-generated project metadata (name, description, TDK, tags) and screenshots, a platform capability map (hosted credentials, knowledge bases, databases, model center, API tools, skill publishing), and the platform rules for developing and publishing API endpoints and SKILL packages.
